T2-F01.problem: acknowledged load-more assertion compared detail.page against the current snapshot's active request with a `? :` self-fallback, degrading to expect(detail.page).toBe(detail.page) when the request was absent/non-page.
T2-F01.resolution: Test now establishes the active request explicitly (not null; kind='loadMore'; position.mode='page'; page=2; requestId != initial search requestId) BEFORE asserting detail. detail.page=2, detail.request.position={mode:'page',page:2}, detail.request.requestId/queryGeneration pinned to the active request. No self-comparison. Fails if no page-mode load-more request exists.
T2-F01.test: packages/core/tests/w1-p1-5-t2-async-data-loading-events.spec.ts#emits an acknowledged loadMore event carrying a fresh page-mode load-more request at page 2

T2-F02.problem: Only 'one diagnostic for one completion' was asserted; the diagnostic payload was not checked, and boundedness was overstated (a replayed completion re-emits). The acknowledgedProjectionFailed diagnostic was not documented.
T2-F02.resolution: Asserts the resource-limit diagnostic payload detail.{reason:'cursor-token-size',maxCursorTokenBytes:1024,actualCursorTokenBytes:50000,requestId} and the snapshot resourceLimit mirror. Proves boundedness is per-result not global (replayed completion -> 2 diagnostics). A healthy-success test asserts 0 diagnostics and documents that acknowledgedProjectionFailed is NOT characterized. EVENT-012 reclassified Existing -> Partial. No private failure injection introduced.

T2-F04.problem: Ledger stated the failed projection is 'only reachable via _failNextAcknowledgedProjectionForTest'; production has a general projection-exception path calling _recordAcknowledgedProjectionFailure, so the absolute claim was overstated.
T2-F04.resolution: Narrowed to: no deterministic PUBLIC trigger for the failed-projection variant was established in this increment; existing private-seam tests exercise it but do not qualify as public-surface evidence. EVENT-020 stays Partial.

T2-F05.problem: Negative runtime tests could be read as proving the event can never be emitted; the source-inspection finding (declared, no dispatch site) was conflated with the runtime observation.
T2-F05.resolution: Tests renamed to '(bounded runtime observation)' and an in-spec boundary note separates the runtime negative from the source inspection; neither over-claims. EVENT-005 stays Missing; DEVIATION-02 ADR candidate.

notes: EVENT-020 'failed' projection and its acknowledgedProjectionFailed diagnostic are not publicly triggerable in this increment; recorded as a public-unobservable gap per plan §7 risk 2 (analogous to ATTR-023). The absolute 'only reachable via private seam' claim is replaced with 'no deterministic public trigger established'.
EVENT-012 boundedness is per-result, not global: a replayed completion against the still-active request re-emits a resource-limit diagnostic (proven in-spec).
EVENT-005 runtime negative and the declared-only source inspection are recorded as separate, non-over-claiming evidence.
